design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — booking_changes_desk task 0 (non-workflow; root = booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill)

0. SCOPE SNAPSHOT (Step 0)
- Difficulty claim: category booking; claimable events include booking_amendment_fee_charged, booking_charge_waived, booking_roll_compensation_credited, booking_documents_received, booking_late_document_fee_charged, booking_cancelled/fee. M=2, exactly one workflow overall.
- Already occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: booking_ext_destination_change_fee (tool charge_destination_change_fee_9814adc0), booking_ext_customer_roll_fee (charge_customer_roll_fee_5e1ab19d), booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill (waive_customer_roll_fee_66cbaf18); workflows [].
- Reserved for task 1 (the workflow task): the carrier-roll compensation credit (booking_roll_compensation_credited), the customer's own document submissions (booking_documents_received, the only genuinely customer-performed booking act) and the late shipping-instruction / late VGM rows (booking_late_document_fee_charged). That space holds a zero-wait SOP with three computing steps on tools disjoint from this task (5 steps with two owner=user steps in round 1; 4 steps with one owner=user step after the round-2 rework of task 1). Cancellation was examined and rejected for both tasks: fees on a cancelled booking are blocked by booking_amendment's live-status gate, and a cancellation SOP has no genuine customer-performed step.
- Design thesis: surface goal "waive the charge for my second move" -> the fee row does not exist yet and the change account is incomplete -> charge the owed change-of-destination fee and the owed customer roll fee -> decide goodwill on the completed account -> waiver row. Depth: 3 problems (root + 2 parallel prerequisites). Breadth: tier ladder (AHL Contract Booking: pod 300.00/container, roll 75.00/container, 1 free roll, authority 250.00, window 45 days, quota 2/365d), ledger reconciliation of pod_change logs vs pod_change_fee rows and customer rolls vs customer_roll_fee rows, cross-category dangerous-goods rejection (2 of 5 containers not carried), cross-category contract shortfall, customer-wide goodwill quota (one waiver already used on another booking).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
The customer asks for one thing — goodwill on a charge she believes exists. The agent must (a) discover by reconciling the ledger that the charge was never booked (two customer roll entries, free allowance one, zero customer_roll_fee rows), (b) read in booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill that goodwill is decided only against a charged row and only on a complete change account, (c) discover a second, unmentioned debt (the 2026-08-26 pod_change entry without pod_change_fee), (d) compute two per-container fees on the containers the line will carry (5 minus the 2 of the rejected UN1479 acceptance), (e) decide the waiver against tier authority, window, contract shortfall and the customer-wide quota. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation and arithmetic; every tool is unambiguous.

2. POLICIES CLAIMED, LINEAGE, OVERRIDES
- booking_ext_destination_change_fee (state_due, subject booking_amendment_fee_charged, base refs booking_amendment + booking_rollover = every base policy governing that event). Refines booking_amendment's change-of-destination fee. Override declared: "it is charged pod_change_fee_per_container_usd times the booking's container_count whatever the free allowance" -> "The fee is pod_change_fee_per_container_usd times the chargeable containers, one fee row per change, whatever the free allowance, and the product is rounded to two decimal places only at the end." Inherited unchanged: pod_change_allowed gate, amendment status gate, lead-time gate, count toward allowance.
- booking_ext_customer_roll_fee (state_due, same subject and refs). Override declared on booking_rollover: "is otherwise charged customer_roll_fee_per_container_usd times the container_count" -> chargeable containers. Inherited: free allowance comparison including the roll handled, max-rolls cap gate, carrier rolls never charged.
- booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill (on_request, subject booking_charge_waived, refs booking_cancellation + booking_goodwill_waiver (governing) plus booking_rollover + booking_amendment (input lineage of the completeness factor)). Override declared on booking_goodwill_waiver: "A fee that fails any of these conditions stays payable, and the desk has no authority to reduce it." -> "When any of these conditions fails, no waiver is written, the fee stays payable, and the desk has no authority to reduce it." because the list of conditions now also contains completeness and the contract-shortfall condition. Inherited: whole-row waiver, authority, window (computed), quota and once-per-row (gates).
- Cross-category: dg container_count of the rejected acceptance (numeric) in both fees; contract shortfall_balance_usd (numeric) in the waiver. Both genuinely exercised in the seed (rejected acceptance ca9147cf with 2 containers; contract 46258245 with shortfall 0.00).

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD (per exact write subject)
- booking_amendment_fee_charged (actions 7 and 9): amend_live_booking — status confirmed (bookings.27740ead.status) ✓; amend_before_lead_time — anchor bookings.cargo_cutoff 2026-09-18T18:00, AHL Contract Booking lead 48 elapsed hours, deadline 2026-09-16T18:00 CNNGB local, relation not_after, inclusive; frozen 2026-09-09 15:20 CST ✓ (fails from 2026-09-16T18:01); customer_roll_cap — customer rolls so far 2 < max 3 ✓ (a third roll would still be allowed, a fourth refused).
- booking_charge_waived (action 11): booking_cancellation has no gate on this subject (policy_scope). booking_goodwill_waiver: within_authority 225.00 <= 250.00 ✓ (fee row from action 9); within_quota — goodwill waivers of the customer in the 365 days to 2026-09-09: 1 (2025-11-14 on AHLU25NGB139052) < 2 ✓; within_request_window — anchor booking_charges.event_date 2026-09-09, 45 calendar days, last day 2026-10-24 inclusive ✓; waive_once — no waiver references bkc_e17b792c4356 ✓.

4. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target: booking AHLU26NGB152718 (27740ead). Pod fee correlates to pod_change entry cf174a03 (vessel_voyage AHL ELBE EXPRESS 614W). Roll fee correlates to the latest customer roll e7201e29 (off AHL ALSTER TRADER 615W); roll 9945af8c (off 614W) is the free one. Waiver correlates to the new fee row bkc_e17b792c4356 via reference_event_id. Excluded: confirmation charges and payment (settled, 8760.00 each way); the closed booking AHLU25NGB139052 and its 240.00 roll fee already waived (counts only toward the customer-wide quota, never toward this booking's owed fees).

5. INITIAL_STATE — WHY EACH ROW EXISTS
customers ea30e93a (identity, credit_approved). service_contracts 46258245 (AHL Regional Account Contract, active, lane asia_north_europe, shortfall 0.00: enables contract rating and is the waiver's cross-category factor; remove it and the waiver drops to 0). bookings 27740ead (the object; container_count 5, cargo_type dangerous_goods, confirmed, cut-offs far enough for the lead-time gate) and 2c1a9cd1 (closed spot Guaranteed Loading booking whose 2025-11-14 goodwill waiver uses one of the two quota slots). dg_acceptances 86c89223 (approved, 3 containers) and ca9147cf (rejected, 2 containers: remove it and both fees become 1500.00/375.00). booking_charges: 5 confirmation charges + payment (settled history teaching the tier's surcharge arithmetic), pod_change log cf174a03 (the unmet prerequisite of edge E6->E5), two customer roll logs (the unmet prerequisite of edge E6->E4), and on the closed booking freight rows, payment, one customer roll, its 240.00 fee and the goodwill waiver of it. Automatic clauses checked: no no-show (vessel not departed), no late documents (SI/VGM cut-offs 2026-09-17/18 not reached), no cancellation, no compensation (no carrier roll), no unsettled status beyond the two owed fees this task charges.

6. PROBLEM-TREE CARD
root booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill.
- edge 1 -> booking_ext_customer_roll_fee, kind value_input, gate fee_amount; condition "The customer roll fee row the customer wants waived is already charged on the booking's account."; policy_source "A goodwill waiver is decided only against a fee row already on the booking's account"; resolved_by charge_customer_roll_fee_5e1ab19d. False at opening: two customer roll rows (9945af8c, e7201e29) and no customer_roll_fee row; bookings.27740ead.charges_due_usd 0.0.
- edge 2 -> booking_ext_destination_change_fee, kind value_input, gate pod_changes_owing; condition "No change of port of discharge on the booking is left without its change-of-destination fee."; policy_source "before a customer roll fee is waived, every change-of-destination fee and customer roll fee the booking owes must already be charged"; resolved_by charge_destination_change_fee_9814adc0. False at opening: booking_charges.cf174a03.amendment_type = pod_change with no pod_change_fee row.
- Shape: parallel. Topological order used by gold: destination fee (action 7), roll fee (action 9), waiver (action 11). Swapped order replay: identical hash e4a634e5…7a89, fees unchanged.
- Sensitivity run (verify.py): skip action 7 -> waiver result 0 (pod_changes_owing 1); skip action 9 -> waiver result 0 (fee_amount 0). Both edges load-bearing.
- No user hint: persona asks only for goodwill on the second move; the Antwerp switch appears only as a reaction after the agent names that charge.
- Tools do not block: all three tools write unconditionally (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

7. PERSONA DESIGN
Lin Meixia, brisk logistics manager. Volunteered: booking number, the second move at the end of last week (roll 2026-09-05 is a Saturday; frozen date is Wednesday 2026-09-09), belief that a charge applies, goodwill request, authority to act. On request only: phone +8657181406325, customer code AHL-CN-163904, email, container reality (three shipping, oxidizer refused — consistent with the dg rows), contract status unknown. Passive reactions: accepts the destination-change charge once the agent names it; accepts booking the roll fee before waiving it; closes on "waiver granted" or on refusal. She knows no amount and never suggests one. Verification needs two of the stated credentials; customer_id is never in the persona.

8. REACHABILITY WALK
Turn 1 goal -> agent asks identity -> find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, code) -> find_bookings(customer) -> find_booking_charges(customer) shows the uncharged pod_change and two customer rolls, plus the closed booking's waiver -> find_dg_acceptances(booking) shows 2 rejected containers -> find_service_contracts(customer) shows shortfall 0.00 -> KB booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill reveals both prerequisites and names booking_ext_customer_roll_fee; the fee policies name their tools -> unlock/call pod fee 900.00 -> unlock/call roll fee 225.00 (receipt returns bkc_e17b792c4356) -> unlock/call waiver 225.00 referencing that row -> agent reports -> customer closes. Every value is either computed from records or copied from a record or receipt; nothing waits on the real world.

9. VERIFICATION (commands and output)
Command: python scratchpad/verify.py 0 '[[E5,7,B0],[E4,9,B0],[E6,11,B0]]' '[skips]'. Output: E5 per_container_fee 300.0, pod_change_allowed True, changes_logged 1, changes_charged 0, changes_owing 1, rejected_dg_containers 2, chargeable_containers 3, result 900.0. E4 per_container_fee 75.0, free_rolls 1, customer_rolls 2, rolls_owing_fee 1, fees_charged 0, rolls_still_owing 1, rejected 2, chargeable 3, result 225.0. E6 authority 250.0, window 45, roll_fee_rows 1, fee_amount 225.0, fee_date 2026-09-09, pod_changes_owing 0, roll_fees_owing 0, account_complete True, contract_shortfall 0.0, contract_clear True, in_window True, within_authority True, result 225.0. Sensitivity: skip 7 -> 0, skip 9 -> 0. Receipts: pod fee bkc_36964a40f21c (charges_due 900.0), roll fee bkc_e17b792c4356 (1125.0), waiver bkc_9c766538ef09 (900.0). Terminal hash e4a634e5707dd41469ee420f74051a0057c78ad089b50f1a77a483fac9b27a89. computations.expected and gold arguments equal these values.

10. RULE <-> COMPUTE TWO-WAY SWEEP
Forward: every binding quotes its sentence in compute_basis (counts, the rejected-acceptance subtraction, the never-below-zero floor, the pod_change_allowed zero branch, the free-allowance branch, completeness, contract condition with the empty-contract exemption, window on calendar dates, authority above 0.00, rounding at the end). Reverse: every quantity sentence is claimed — "counted from the booking's ledger" (changes_logged/charged), "one fee row per change" (result per call), "the latest customer rolls" (vessel_voyage tracing), "latest customer_roll_fee row by event_date" (fee_amount/fee_date via LATEST), "quota and once-per-row" left to the inherited gates on purpose (no quantity in the waiver amount). Semantics pinned: fees act on the chargeable-container count, not the booking count; a single multiplication; rounding only on the final product; window counts calendar dates inclusive of the last day.

11. EASY MISTAKES AND HOW A CAREFUL AGENT AVOIDS THEM
- Waiving immediately with an invented amount or referencing nothing: impossible without the charged row; policy says charge first.
- Charging on 5 containers (1500.00 / 375.00): the fee rules subtract the rejected acceptance.
- Charging both customer rolls: the first is inside the free allowance.
- Forgetting the pod change: completeness fails, waiver must not be written.
- Counting the closed booking's roll or waiver toward this booking's owed fees: the fee counts are per booking; that waiver matters only for the customer-wide quota (1 < 2).
- Waiving the 900.00 destination fee instead: not requested and above authority.

12. SOLVABILITY CONTRACT VS GT
Action 7 and 9: state_due intent from initial_state rows (cf174a03, e7201e29), preexisting stage facts, gates amend_live_booking / amend_before_lead_time / customer_roll_cap with booking_id bindings. Action 11: on_request intent from the persona's verbatim request, stage established by prior_step 9, goodwill gates bound to reference_event_id from prior_step 9 and customer_id from the seeded waiver row. Temporal entries for the two lead-time gates and the waiver window, each with just-before and at-boundary cases.

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT ONLY
Masking compute/expected: KB prose of the three policies + tool schemas + lookups give: pod fee = 300 per carried container x (5 - 2) = 900; roll fee = 75 x 3 = 225 for the one roll beyond the single free roll; goodwill = full 225 row, conditions met (complete account after both charges, 225 <= 250, same day, contract shortfall 0.00, quota 1 of 2 used). Same objects, same order constraints, same values as gold.

14. MANUAL VALUE GATES (after per-task scripts)
Length/breadth ✓ (3 problems, 6 world factors); need expression ✓ (object, timing today, authority to act, write not quote); chronology ✓ (every volunteered fact is in initial_state; no gold-produced fact is foreseen); base eligibility/time anchors ✓ (card 3); authoritative facts ✓ (status, logs, DG status and contract balance from system rows); reachability/zero-wait ✓ (all synchronous); two-way rule/compute ✓ (section 10); visible-context draft ✓ (section 13).

15. REVISIONS
- r1 check_extended: helper function _balance_after in task_tools.py was counted as an undiscoverable tool -> inlined the balance arithmetic into each tool -> EXTENDED OK.
- r1 replay_tasks: dangling FK bookings.contract_id="" on the spot booking -> seeded contract_id as null (no contract) and changed the waiver's contract condition to "True if not F('contract_id')" so spot bookings stay exempt -> REPLAY OK, recompute unchanged (225.00).
Per-task gates run: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute (3 comps, 32 factors, 8 history rows, 14 branches), check_grounding, check_cross_fire — all OK for --task 0.

16. ROUND 2 — AUDIT RESPONSES (policy_task audit, booking_changes_desk)
- F-D1 / T0-2 (SOURCE-POLICY RED): the prerequisite effects of booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill now state only the general effect of the resolving write. E1: fee_amount is the charged row's amount and the waiver still depends on its other conditions. E2: pod_changes_owing falls to 0, the account is complete only when no customer roll fee is owed either, and the waiver can take the amount only after that. Recomputed in this world: after action 7 alone, account_complete is false (roll_fees_owing 1) and the waiver is 0, as the new text says. After action 9 it is true and the waiver is 225.00.
- T0-1 (SOURCE-CHAIN RED): edges[1].flips_to_true_by now says what holds after action 7 (pod_changes_owing 0, account_complete still false until action 9). edges[0].flips_to_true_by now records that account_complete becomes true at action 9, because action 7 has already run in the gold order.
- T0-6: both edge_load_bearing entries use one reading: replay without the skipped write, recompute the waiver (0, not writable), and compare the terminal ledger (skip 9: no roll-fee or waiver row; skip 7: no pod-fee or waiver row, charges_due 225.00 instead of 900.00).
- T0-5: the persona line "you have not seen it on any invoice yet" is removed. She says only that she does not know the amount. no_user_hint was updated to match.
- F-D2 / T0-3: the added goodwill gates are now declared. booking_goodwill_waiver's "The desk may waive a single fee row as goodwill at the verified customer's request." is superseded by "These conditions are added to those of booking_goodwill_waiver: a customer roll fee row that meets every base condition but fails the complete change account, the positive amount or the contract condition is not waived." That sentence is now in the rule. The value in this world is unchanged (225.00).
- F-D5: the completeness factor now counts a pod change or a customer roll only when it would owe a fee under its own policy (pod_change_allowed, customer_roll_fee_per_container_usd > 0 and chargeable_containers > 0). This adds a dg read to the goodwill policy (cross_category contract + dg). In this world chargeable_containers is 3, so pod_changes_owing and roll_fees_owing are as before (0 after both charges). The waiver is 225.00, and skipping either prerequisite still gives 0.
- F-D8 / T0-4: the general event-order sentence of booking_ext_late_si_record is narrowed to "Roll compensation comes first on a booking the line has rolled …". It no longer orders the two change fees of this task, which stay freely ordered (identical terminal hash in either order).
- F-D6: each of the four policies that subtract the rejected acceptance now says that a booking with more than one rejected acceptance falls outside its rules. This world has exactly one (ca9147cf).
- F-D7: every ledger-writing tool now copies the booking's equipment_type onto the new row and states that no container count is recorded. The gold arguments are unchanged. The rows now carry equipment_type 20DV, so the terminal hash moves consistently for gold and for any agent.
Gates re-run after these changes: see the difficulty-level block recorded in task 1's rationale, section 14.
- Terminal hash after the F-D7 tool change (equipment_type on new rows): e4a634e5707dd41469ee420f74051a0057c78ad089b50f1a77a483fac9b27a89, identical for the swapped charge order (re-run of the order and sensitivity checks: waiver 225.00; skip action 7 -> 0; skip action 9 -> 0; after action 7 alone account_complete false, roll_fees_owing 1). Earlier hash citations in this dossier were updated to this value.
user_scenario:
You are Lin Meixia, logistics manager at Hangzhou Qiantang Fine Chemicals Co., Ltd., a solvent and specialty-chemicals maker that has shipped with Aurelia Hanse Line for years. You call from your office on a busy Wednesday afternoon, polite but brisk, a little worn down from explaining delays to your own sales team.

You open by saying you are calling about booking AHLU26NGB152718 out of Ningbo. At the end of last week you had to ask the line to move it to a later sailing for the second time, because the local safety inspection of your tank farm held up the drum filling, and when you made that second request you were told a charge applies for moving it again. You would like the charge for the second move waived as a goodwill gesture: the inspection was out of your hands and you have been a steady customer. That waiver is the one thing you are calling about; you want it done today if the desk can do it, and you are happy for the agent to put it through on your behalf. You do not know the amount of that charge.

You give your details only when the agent asks for them: your registered phone number is +8657181406325 and your customer code is AHL-CN-163904; if a third detail is wanted, your registered email is lin.meixia@qtfinechem.cn. If the agent asks which booking, you repeat AHLU26NGB152718. If the agent asks how many containers are actually going, you say three, because the line's dangerous-goods team turned down the two containers of oxidizer and only the solvent is shipping. If the agent asks whether anything is owed on your service contract, you say not as far as you know and that they should check their records. You do not know the tariff, the fee amounts or the rules behind them, and you never suggest a figure.

Only if the agent tells you that the change of destination you made in August also carries a charge that has to be put on the account, you think for a second and agree: yes, you switched the discharge port from Hamburg to Antwerp back then, that is fair, go ahead. If the agent says the charge for the second move has to be booked on the account before it can be waived, you say that is fine as long as it ends up waived. Once the agent tells you the goodwill waiver has been granted, you thank them, say that was all you needed, and end the call. If the agent tells you instead that the charge cannot be waived, you say you are disappointed but understand, and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's company profile from the registered phone number Lin Meixia states, to obtain the customer reference used by every later lookup and write.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the customer reference no booking, charge history, contract or dangerous-goods record of the caller can be reached, and identity cannot be verified.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm in session that the caller may act for Hangzhou Qiantang Fine Chemicals, using the two credentials she states (phone number and customer code).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account business, including booking owed fees or granting goodwill, may be transacted for an unverified caller; two matching credentials are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the customer's bookings to find AHLU26NGB152718 (tier AHL Contract Booking, status confirmed, contract reference, container_count 5, cargo_type dangerous_goods, cargo_cutoff 2026-09-18T18:00) and to see the closed booking AHLU25NGB139052.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier fixes every parameter of the three calculations, the status and cargo cut-off are the amendment-charge gates, container_count is the base of both per-container fees, and contract_id leads to the goodwill contract condition.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the full charge history of both bookings: on AHLU26NGB152718 the confirmation charges, the payment, the pod_change amendment entry of 2026-08-26 with no pod_change_fee after it, and the two customer roll entries of 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-05 with no customer_roll_fee; on AHLU25NGB139052 the goodwill waiver of 2025-11-14.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the ledger reconciliation that reveals both prerequisites: the change of destination and the second customer roll are owed but uncharged, which is what blocks the goodwill decision; the earlier waiver is the one goodwill already used in the trailing 365 days for the quota gate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the two dangerous-goods acceptances of the booking: UN1993 approved on 3 containers and UN1479 rejected on 2 containers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The rejected acceptance's container_count 2 is subtracted from the booking's 5 containers in both the change-of-destination fee and the customer roll fee; without it both fees are overstated.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the AHL Regional Account Contract the booking is rated under, in particular its shortfall_balance_usd 0.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Goodwill on a contract-rated booking is granted only while the contract's unpaid shortfall is exactly 0.00; this is the cross-category condition of the waiver.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the change-of-destination fee charge tool named by booking_ext_destination_change_fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no effect on the records.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Charge the change-of-destination fee owed since the 2026-08-26 change from DEHAM to BEANR, so the booking's change account is complete.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: booking_ext_roll_fee_goodwill decides goodwill only on a complete change account; booking_ext_destination_change_fee computes the fee 900.00.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_usd: 900.00 = pod_change_fee_per_container_usd 300.00 x chargeable containers 3 (container_count 5 minus the 2 containers of the rejected UN1479 acceptance), one change owing (1 pod_change log - 0 pod_change_fee rows), pod_change_allowed true; charging 5 containers (1500.00) ignores the rejected acceptance.

temporal_feasibility.condition: An amendment is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's amendment_lead_hours_before_cargo_cutoff before the cargo cut-off of the allocated vessel.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the cargo cut-off of the allocated vessel
temporal_basis.counting_rule: The amendment deadline is the cargo cut-off time minus the tier's lead hours, counted as full 60-minute hours in port-of-loading local time, and an amendment received exactly at the deadline is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: AHL Contract Booking has 48 lead hours, so the deadline is 2026-09-16T18:00 CNNGB local time; a charge handled at 2026-09-16T18:01 would fall after the deadline, and the amendment charge could no longer be accepted.

edges.condition: The customer roll fee row the customer wants waived is already charged on the booking's account.
edges.policy_source: A goodwill waiver is decided only against a fee row already on the booking's account

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The booking has two customer roll entries against a free allowance of one, yet no customer_roll_fee entry exists at all, so there is no fee row to waive.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Action 9 writes customer_roll_fee row bkc_e17b792c4356 of 225.00; fee_amount moves from 0 to 225.00, and because the destination-change fee was already charged at action 7, account_complete becomes true at the same moment.

edges.condition: No change of port of discharge on the booking is left without its change-of-destination fee.
edges.policy_source: before a customer roll fee is waived, every change-of-destination fee and customer roll fee the booking owes must already be charged

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The pod_change amendment of 2026-08-26 has no pod_change_fee row after it, so the change account is incomplete.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Action 7 writes the 900.00 pod_change_fee row; from that moment pod_changes_owing is 0, so the destination-change half of the complete-account condition holds. account_complete itself stays false until action 9 also charges the customer roll fee (roll_fees_owing (2 - 1) - 0 = 1 after action 7, 0 after action 9); only then can the waiver take the fee row's amount.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and independent: the change-of-destination fee reads only pod_change entries and the customer roll fee reads only customer roll entries, and each writes a row the other never reads. The verification run replayed the gold with the customer roll fee charged before the change-of-destination fee: both fees stayed 900.00 and 225.00 and the terminal hash was identical (e4a634e5707dd41469ee420f74051a0057c78ad089b50f1a77a483fac9b27a89). Only the waiver must come last.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Replay without action 9 and recompute the waiver: roll_fee_rows 0 and fee_amount 0, so the waiver result is 0 and no waiver may be written. Terminal difference under that reading: no customer_roll_fee row and no waiver row; charges_due ends at 900.00 either way, but the ledger rows differ.

Replay without action 7 and recompute the waiver: pod_changes_owing 1, account_complete false, waiver result 0, so no waiver may be written. Terminal difference under that reading: no pod_change_fee row and no waiver row, and charges_due ends at 225.00 (the unwaived customer roll fee) instead of 900.00.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona volunteers only the goodwill request on the second move and that a charge was mentioned when the move was requested. It never names the change-of-destination fee, never says or implies whether the roll fee is on the account, and mentions the Antwerp switch only as a reaction after the agent says that change carries a charge.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: waive_customer_roll_fee_66cbaf18 writes the waiver row and lowers charges_due for whatever reference and amount it is given; it does not look for the fee row, check the change account or the contract. charge_destination_change_fee_9814adc0 and charge_customer_roll_fee_5e1ab19d likewise write their row unconditionally. An agent that waives before booking the fees gets a normal receipt and a wrong terminal state.
